question: What claim is made about the identity of the soul as the more supreme one who is also called Haṃsa and power-individual?
premises: He is the soul and more supreme.
That same one is called Haṃsa.
That same one is designated as power-individual.
inference: The soul is the more supreme one who is Haṃsa and power-individual.
uncertainties: The precise relation between power and individual remains unspecified.
plain_english: He is the soul, more supreme. Indeed, he is Haṃsa, the power-individual.
